Iconoir icon audit

Snapshot e24c7d29
Iconoir React 7.12.1

186 functional entries have a first-choice rationale; 178 include compared candidates. Among 103 active shared aliases: 78 direct fits, 25 adaptations, 0 without a candidate. Recommendations reflect the specific action, destination, state and small-size appearance; a viable alternative is not automatically an error.

Behavior-based selection review: decisions and evidence

Each functional entry has an explicit selection review. Competing candidates are shown with their actual artwork and context-specific tradeoffs. Simple conventional symbols retain their established meaning; choosing a first candidate does not make every other candidate incorrect.

  • Opening targets: OpenInBrowser for known web pages; OpenInWindow for local files in their default application; ArrowRight for internal navigation; ViewColumns2 for a second pane. The shared preview source already distinguishes URL from file. The direction of an arrow is interpreted together with its destination frame.
  • Audio content: VoiceSquare replaces the headphone proposal. Its waveform depicts speech/music content and matches the other framed media icons.
  • Time: Clock for a time of day; Timer for elapsed duration; Calendar for the scheduled-automation entity. A clock was usable for all three, but the specific behaviors have clearer candidates.
  • Apply Template: retain Copy as the first choice for copying missing template content into tagged nodes. PlaylistPlus is a viable addition-focused alternative. This is not a current-icon error.
  • Optional refinements: PinSlash for Unpin and CheckSquare for Mark Done make inverse commands clearer; their current labeled icons are still usable. The same distinction applies to Timer versus Clock for duration.
  • Email action: email fields construct mailto links, but the host currently accepts only HTTP(S). This blocked behavior is recorded separately; changing the glyph is insufficient.
  • State and grouping: keep the corrected reference direction, actual media volume thresholds, filled Stop square and operation-aware tool-group recommendations. Mixed groups must not borrow an inaccurate first-member icon.
  • Visibility: Open, Capture, Create and Outdent registry cases have no visible icons in the text-only Launcher action panel. Their recommendations remain contract notes rather than visible UI errors.

Context-dependent choices remain explicit: DesignPencil for Highlight; Brain for Agent; HSquare for Heading; List for Outline; TaskList for a plan object. These are recommendations with labels and state requirements, not claims of identical semantics outside their surfaces.

Scope, counting and migration constraints

Every shared alias and imported Launcher component is represented below, including every recorded use site. Rows split when the same symbol names different operations. 720 TS/TSX files were scanned; CSS masks, inline SVG, text symbols and local identity assets were also inspected. Coverage checks report zero uncovered entries.

Direct fit means a suitable direct expression of the intended action, not the only correct glyph. Adaptation uses a related visual metaphor, rotation or motion with the stated context. Gap means no suitable direct or contextual candidate has been identified. The Gap substitutes filter isolates Highlight, Loading and the top-toolbar pair. Intentional exceptions are identity assets, text conventions and stateful primitives, excluded from the functional gap count. Unused aliases are reviewed provisionally, not treated as live behavior.

The package contains 1383 regular and 288 solid components. 209 relevant candidates were inspected as rendered graphics; the table uses 116 distinct candidates. Package-wide name searches supplement that review; this is not a claim that every catalogue icon was individually evaluated. Current Lucide and proposed Iconoir samples are shown at 24 / 16 / 14 / 12px with each library's default stroke. Production includes 10px slots and stroke overrides, so final optical weight must be verified in the app.

Iconoir React supports the app's React version and tree-shaken named imports, but uses width/height rather than Lucide's size prop. A future migration needs the central adapter, Launcher mapping, CSS file masks, semantic action resolver, and live-state tests. Keep the filled Stop square, disclosure rotations, currentColor, fixed slots, tooltips and reduced-motion behavior. All active shared aliases now have candidates under the contextual-substitution criterion; the adaptations still require verification in their real controls, particularly Highlight recognition and the distinction between busy status and Retry.

Open claims inspected for this snapshot: #628 overlaps AgentSettingsView and retires some Agent/Skill surfaces; #626 describes later Settings work; #629 concerns startup. Re-inventory after integration before implementing. The report does not migrate product code or establish real-Electron visual acceptance. It supersedes earlier Lucide-only suggestions such as using Calculator for every number field.

Catalogue and package evidence: Iconoir catalogue · React package · Pinned package metadata. Iconoir is MIT licensed; notices are retained below. Icons and images are embedded; no network is required to view the table.
